papers.abstract_zh: 背景:临床宏基因组学 (CMg) 提供高通量呼吸道病原体检测,其范围比靶向、探针依赖性诊断更广泛。测序成本和高 宿主 生物量的挑战是使用 CMg 在鼻咽拭子等非侵入性样本中进行高通量呼吸道病原体检测的障碍。方法:我们优化了纳米孔测序工作流程,通过背景核酸去除和 SISPA 扩增以及牛津纳米孔技术 (ONT) 测序,采用病原体富集来检测鼻咽拭子中的 RNA 病毒。作为未知病原体检测的先决条件,我们首先根据由常规多重 PCR 检测到的 23 个病原体目标组成的黄金标准得出质量控制 (QC) 标准和诊断阈值。在这项诊断准确性研究中,我们使用 344 个前瞻性收集的上呼吸道样本(提交用于常规测试)验证了该工作流程。结果:使用预定义的 QC 和阳性标准,工作流程相对于 PCR 的敏感性为 51% (95%CI: 45%-57%)(检测到 133/260 个阳性目标)(在超过 20 个金标准检测的病原体中,敏感性为 19%-85%),特异性为 99.8%(95%CI:99.6%-99.9%) (未检测到 3836/3845 个阴性目标)。使用事后优化阈值,灵敏度提高至 58% (159/274),仅考虑 RNA 病原体,灵敏度提高至 61% (159/260),排除鼻病毒/肠道病毒,灵敏度提高至 70% (144/207),排除工作流程后 qPCR Ct 值≥35 的样本,灵敏度提高至 83% (140/169)。多重测序的读取交叉造成了大部分 (7/9) 的假阳性。仅鉴定出 2 种可能的其他病原体(鼻病毒和冠状病毒 OC43)。通过测序成功对 41 种 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV)、13 种甲型流感病毒和 10 种鼻病毒/肠道病毒进行了亚型分型。多重纳米孔测序成本为 112 英镑/样本。解释:虽然 CMg 具有巨大的诊断潜力,但这项验证研究表明,当前应用于具有高 宿主 和低病原体生物量的上呼吸道样本病毒检测的宏基因组测序方法存在技术局限性。它对较高病毒载量具有更高的敏感性,这表明确定最合适的用例以最大化其效用和价值的重要性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 临床宏基因组学提供高通量呼吸道病原体检测,其范围比有针对性的、依赖于探针的诊断更广泛。该研究旨在验证用于检测病毒呼吸道病原体的优化宏基因组纳米孔测序方法。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项诊断准确性研究使用 344 份前瞻性收集的上呼吸道样本(提交用于常规检测)验证了测序工作流程。该研究在临床环境中进行,旨在根据由常规多重 PCR 检测到的 23 个病原体目标组成的金标准来评估该方法的性能。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究优化了纳米孔测序工作流程,以检测鼻咽拭子中的 RNA 病毒,通过背景核酸去除和 SISPA 扩增来富集病原体,并使用牛津纳米孔技术 (ONT) 测序。质量控制 (QC) 标准和诊断阈值是根据由常规多重 PCR 检测到的 23 个病原体目标组成的金标准得出的。
analysis_zh.main_results: 使用预定义的 QC 和阳性标准,工作流程与 PCR 相比的灵敏度为 51% (95%CI: 45%-57%)(检测到 133/260 个阳性目标)(在超过 20 个金标准检测的病原体中,灵敏度为 19%-85%),特异性为 99.8% (95%CI: 99.6%-99.9%)(3836/3845 个阴性目标)未检测到)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究证明了当前宏基因组测序方法应用于高 宿主 和低病原体生物量的上呼吸道样本病毒检测的技术局限性。它对较高病毒载量具有更高的敏感性,凸显了确定最合适的用例以最大化其效用和价值的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为开发更有效的病毒呼吸道病原体检测宏基因组测序方法提供了信息,特别是在需要高通量和广谱检测的临床环境中。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据受到非侵入性样本中高宿主生物量和低病原体生物量的技术挑战的限制,这可能会影响宏基因组测序方法的准确性。由于这些限制,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Updated Evidence for COVID-19, RSV, and Influenza Vaccines for 2025-2026
papers.abstract: 2025 Dec 4;393(22):2221–2242. doi: 10.1056/NEJMsa2514268) In the United States, changes in federal messaging surrounding vaccines have caused disruption to guidance for immunization, though it is known that respiratory illnesses such as respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), influenza, and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2/COVID-19) can become severe and result in hospitalization, particularly in children under a year of age and in the elderly (65 and older). Recent changes in federal processes have underscored the need for independent evaluation of evidence surrounding these immunizations. This study is a systematic review of recent data surrounding respiratory virus epidemiology, vaccine and immunization efficacy and safety to formulate recommendations for the 2025-2026 respiratory virus season.

papers.title: Deciphering the association between Sirt2 modulation and non-canonical Wnt/planar cell polarity-dependent splenic junctional priming: a comparative study of two Sirt2 modulators in murine endotoxemia.
papers.abstract: Enhancement of the splenic function by preserving its cellular/junctional integrity is an underrated effective strategy in combatting infections. The present work aimed to assess the effect of sirtuin (Sirt) modulation in splenic dysfunction associated with lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced endotoxemia in rats. Endotoxemia was induced by a single LPS injection (10 mg/kg; i.p) either solely or preceded by one of 2 Sirt modulators for 3 days; AGK2 (41 mg/kg/d; i.p) or resveratrol (RSV; 40 mg/kg/d; i.p). The results revealed an existing association between AGK2-mediated Sirt-2 inhibition and wingless homolog Wnt5a refining with contemporaneous stimulation of the splenic receptor tyrosine kinase like orphan receptor-2/Frizzled-4/Dishevelled-2 axis. This coincided with enhancement of the planar cell polarity stream (PCP) components, namely, Guanosine-5'-triphosphate-bound Ras homolog family member-A/rho-associated coil-containing protein kinase-1/2, that was in turn linked to augmentation of splenic VE-cadherin content and immunohistochemical expression and instigation of focal adhesion kinase activating phosphorylation. These events were accompanied by enhanced splenic count of differentiated T cells to halt the plasma endotoxin increment with partial suppression of the resultant cytokine storm. The biochemical amendment was further validated by restoration of splenic macro- and microscopic architecture, improved survival and clinical outcomes, and amelioration of end-organ damage markers. Resveratrol failed to achieve such remarkable effects; a conclusion that might be attributed to the hinderance of its anti-inflammatory actions by its Sirt-2 activating capacity, leading to eventual mild endotoxin level decrement in the experimental model. The Sirt2 selective inhibition might be superior in renovating splenic patterning by fine-tuning the Wnt5a/PCP axis and reconstructing junctional scaffolding that functions to expand the blood filtration capacity, besides, immune cells synthesis and migration, presenting a novel approach to conquer the underlying endotoxemia.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the understudied role of splenic cellular and junctional integrity in infection control and sought to evaluate whether sirtuin (Sirt) modulation could mitigate splenic dysfunction during lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced endotoxemia in rats.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An experimental study induced endotoxemia in rats via a single intraperitoneal LPS injection (10 mg/kg), with or without prior administration of two Sirt modulators—AGK2 (41 mg/kg/day) or resveratrol (RSV; 40 mg/kg/day)—for three days.
analysis.methods: Sirt modulators were administered intraperitoneally for three days prior to LPS challenge. Biochemical and histological assessments were performed to evaluate splenic architecture, immune cell differentiation, and signaling pathways, including the Wnt5a/planar cell polarity (PCP) axis and related molecular markers.
analysis.main_results: AGK2-mediated Sirt2 inhibition was associated with activation of the Wnt5a/PCP pathway, increased splenic VE-cadherin content, and immunohistochemical expression, alongside enhanced T-cell differentiation and partial suppression of cytokine storm and endotoxin levels. Resveratrol did not achieve comparable effects.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted Sirt2 inhibition as superior in restoring splenic junctional integrity and immune function by fine-tuning the Wnt5a/PCP axis, presenting a novel therapeutic avenue for endotoxemia management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that selective Sirt2 inhibition may improve splenic function and clinical outcomes in endotoxemia, potentially informing future strategies for infection control and immune modulation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its animal model design, lack of randomization, and reliance on a single endotoxemia model, which constrains generalizability to human infections; the evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to these constraints.

analysis.summary_en: This experimental study in rats evaluated the effect of two Sirt modulators, AGK2 and resveratrol, on splenic dysfunction during LPS-induced endotoxemia. AGK2, a Sirt2 inhibitor, was associated with activation of the Wnt5a/planar cell polarity pathway, increased splenic VE-cadherin content, and enhanced T-cell differentiation, alongside partial suppression of cytokine storm and endotoxin levels. Resveratrol, a Sirt2 activator, failed to produce comparable effects. The authors propose that selective Sirt2 inhibition may restore splenic junctional integrity and immune function, offering a novel therapeutic approach for endotoxemia. However, the study’s animal model design, lack of randomization, and reliance on a single endotoxemia model limit generalizability to human infections, warranting cautious interpretation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究探讨了脾细胞和连接完整性在感染控制中的尚未被研究的作用,并试图评估去乙酰化酶 (Sirt) 的调节是否可以减轻脂多糖 (LPS) 诱导的大鼠内毒素血症期间的脾功能障碍。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项实验研究通过单次腹膜内注射 LPS (10 mg/kg) 诱导大鼠内毒素血症,并预先给予或不给予两种 Sirt 调节剂——AGK2(41 mg/kg/天)或白藜芦醇(RSV;40 mg/kg/天)——持续三天。
elements_zh.methods: 在 LPS 攻击前三天腹膜内施用 Sirt 调节剂。进行生化和组织学评估以评估脾结构、免疫细胞分化和信号通路,包括 Wnt5a/平面细胞极性 (PCP) 轴和相关分子标记。
elements_zh.main_results: AGK2 介导的 Sirt2 抑制与 Wnt5a/PCP 通路的激活、脾 VE-钙粘蛋白含量增加和免疫组织化学表达相关,同时增强 T 细胞分化以及部分抑制细胞因子风暴和内毒素水平。白藜芦醇没有达到类似的效果。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为 Sirt2 抑制通过微调 Wnt5a/PCP 轴在恢复脾连接完整性和免疫功能方面具有优越性,为内毒素血症管理提供了一种新的治疗途径。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,选择性 Sirt2 抑制可能会改善内毒素血症的脾功能和临床结果,可能为未来的感染控制和免疫调节策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到动物模型设计、缺乏随机性以及对单一内毒素血症模型的依赖的限制,这限制了对人类感染的普遍适用性;由于这些限制,证据强度被评估为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 通过保持细胞/连接完整性来增强脾功能是对抗感染的一种被低估的有效策略。目前的工作旨在评估沉默调节蛋白(Sirt)调节对与脂多糖(LPS)诱导的内毒素血症相关的大鼠脾功能障碍的影响。内毒素血症是通过单次 LPS 注射(10 mg/kg;腹腔注射)诱导的,可以单独注射,也可以先注射 2 种 Sirt 调节剂中的一种,注射 3 天;AGK2(41 mg/kg/d;腹腔注射)或白藜芦醇(RSV;40 mg/kg/d;腹腔注射)。结果揭示了 AGK2 介导的 Sirt-2 抑制和无翼同源物 Wnt5a 精炼与同时刺激脾受体酪氨酸激酶(如孤受体 2/Frizzled-4/Dishevelled-2 轴)之间存在关联。这与平面细胞极性流(PCP)成分的增强相一致,即鸟苷-5'-三磷酸结合的Ras同源物家族成员-A/rho相关线圈的蛋白激酶-1/2,这反过来又与脾VE-钙粘蛋白含量和免疫组织化学表达的增加以及粘着斑激酶激活磷酸化的刺激有关。这些事件伴随着脾脏分化 T 细胞计数的增加,以阻止血浆内毒素的增加,并部分抑制由此产生的细胞因子风暴。通过恢复脾脏宏观和微观结构、改善生存和临床结果以及改善终末器官损伤标志物,进一步验证了生化修正。白藜芦醇未能达到如此显着的效果;这一结论可能归因于其 Sirt-2 激活能力阻碍了其抗炎作用,最终导致实验模型中内毒素水平轻度下降。Sirt2选择性抑制可能在通过微调Wnt5a/PCP轴和重建具有扩大血液过滤能力的连接支架来更新脾脏模式方面具有优势,此外,免疫细胞的合成和迁移也提供了一种克服潜在内毒素血症的新方法。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项实验研究通过单次腹膜内注射 LPS (10 mg/kg) 诱导大鼠内毒素血症,并预先给予或不给予两种 Sirt 调节剂——AGK2(41 mg/kg/天)或白藜芦醇(RSV;40 mg/kg/天)——持续三天。
analysis_zh.methods: 在 LPS 攻击前三天腹膜内施用 Sirt 调节剂。进行生化和组织学评估以评估脾结构、免疫细胞分化和信号通路,包括 Wnt5a/平面细胞极性 (PCP) 轴和相关分子标记。
analysis_zh.main_results: AGK2 介导的 Sirt2 抑制与 Wnt5a/PCP 通路的激活、脾 VE-钙粘蛋白含量增加和免疫组织化学表达相关,同时增强 T 细胞分化以及部分抑制细胞因子风暴和内毒素水平。白藜芦醇没有达到类似的效果。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为 Sirt2 抑制通过微调 Wnt5a/PCP 轴在恢复脾连接完整性和免疫功能方面具有优越性,为内毒素血症管理提供了一种新的治疗途径。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,选择性 Sirt2 抑制可能会改善内毒素血症的脾功能和临床结果,可能为未来的感染控制和免疫调节策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到动物模型设计、缺乏随机性以及对单一内毒素血症模型的依赖的限制,这限制了对人类感染的普遍适用性;由于这些限制,证据强度被评估为中等。

papers.title: Priority setting for older adult vaccines in Indonesia: a multi-criteria decision analysis using SMART vaccines.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Indonesia's aging population faces substantial vaccine-preventable disease burdens, while vaccine introduction decisions remain constrained by limited resources and the absence of a prioritization framework. This study prioritized vaccines for older adults in Indonesia using a structured prioritization approach. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: A multi-criteria decision analysis was conducted using the Strategic Multi-Attribute Ranking Tool for Vaccines. Influenza vaccine (IV), pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV), recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV), and respiratory syncytial virus vaccine (RSVV) were assessed across 10 attributes. Stakeholders confirmed vaccine candidates, validated criteria, assigned weights, and scored vaccines. One-way sensitivity analyses and an exploratory proxy uncertainty analysis were performed to assess ranking robustness. RESULTS: Seventeen representatives from ten stakeholder institutions participated. The highest weighted attributes were quality-adjusted life years gained/disability-adjusted life years averted (14.44%), relevance to older adult public health priorities (12.78%), premature deaths averted (11.89%), net budget impact (11.44%), and cost-effectiveness (11.22%). Composite scores ranked IV first (858.25), followed by PCV (809.24), RSVV (569.39), and RZV (558.03). Rankings remained unchanged across all sensitivity and proxy uncertainty analyses. CONCLUSIONS: IV was the highest-priority vaccine for older adults in Indonesia, followed by PCV, RSVV, and RZV. This framework provides an evidence-informed basis for vaccine policy and healthy aging strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 印度尼西亚在老年人中面临着巨大的 疫苗 可预防疾病负担,同时引入 疫苗 的资源也有限,因此需要一个结构化的优先顺序框架来指导 疫苗 政策决策。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用多标准决策分析和 疫苗 战略多属性排名工具来优先考虑印度尼西亚老年人的 疫苗,涉及来自 10 个利益相关机构的 17 名代表。
elements_zh.methods: 该分析评估了四种 疫苗(流感 疫苗、肺炎球菌结合物 疫苗、重组带状疱疹 疫苗 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗)的 10 个属性,由利益相关者分配权重并对 疫苗 进行评分。
elements_zh.main_results: 综合评分中,流感 疫苗 排名第一 (858.25),其次是肺炎球菌结合物 疫苗 (809.24)、呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗 (569.39) 和重组带状疱疹 疫苗 (558.03)。所有敏感性和代理不确定性分析的排名均保持不变。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该框架将流感 疫苗 确定为印度尼西亚老年人的最高优先级 疫苗,为政策决策和健康老龄化战略提供了循证基础。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 优先顺序框架可以为印度尼西亚老年人免疫规划的基于证据的 疫苗 政策和资源分配提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究对利益相关者的意见和抽象证据的依赖限制了普遍性,并且缺乏临床或流行病学数据使结论的强度降低到中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:印度尼西亚的老龄化人口面临着巨大的 疫苗 可预防疾病负担,而 疫苗 的引入决策仍然受到资源有限和缺乏优先框架的限制。本研究采用结构化优先顺序方法,为印度尼西亚老年人确定了 疫苗 的优先顺序。研究设计和方法:使用 疫苗 的战略多属性排名工具进行多标准决策分析。对流感 疫苗 (IV)、肺炎球菌结合物 疫苗 (PCV)、重组带状疱疹 疫苗 (RZV) 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗 (RSVV) 的 10 个属性进行了评估。利益相关者确认了 疫苗 候选者、验证了标准、分配了权重并对 疫苗 进行了评分。进行单向敏感性分析和探索性代理不确定性分析来评估排名的稳健性。结果:来自 10 个利益相关机构的 17 名代表参加了会议。权重最高的属性是质量调整生命年增加/残疾调整生命年避免(14.44%)、与老年人公共卫生优先事项的相关性(12.78%)、避免过早死亡(11.89%)、净预算影响(11.44%)和成本效益(11.22%)。综合得分排名IV第一(858.25),其次是PCV(809.24)、RSVV(569.39)和RZV(558.03)。所有敏感性和代理不确定性分析的排名均保持不变。结论:IV 是印度尼西亚老年人最优先考虑的 疫苗,其次是 PCV、RSVV 和 RZV。该框架为 疫苗 政策和健康老龄化战略提供了循证基础。

analysis_zh.methods: 该分析评估了四种 疫苗(流感 疫苗、肺炎球菌结合物 疫苗、重组带状疱疹 疫苗 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗)的 10 个属性,由利益相关者分配权重并对 疫苗 进行评分。
analysis_zh.main_results: 综合评分中,流感 疫苗 排名第一 (858.25),其次是肺炎球菌结合物 疫苗 (809.24)、呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗 (569.39) 和重组带状疱疹 疫苗 (558.03)。所有敏感性和代理不确定性分析的排名均保持不变。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该框架将流感 疫苗 确定为印度尼西亚老年人的最高优先级 疫苗,为政策决策和健康老龄化战略提供了循证基础。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 优先顺序框架可以为印度尼西亚老年人免疫规划的基于证据的 疫苗 政策和资源分配提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究对利益相关者的意见和抽象证据的依赖限制了普遍性,并且缺乏临床或流行病学数据使结论的强度降低到中等。

papers.title: Distinguishing common respiratory pathogens using machine learning of symptom profiles to prioritize diagnostic testing.
papers.abstract: Clinical symptoms are critical for diagnosing and managing upper respiratory tract infections, yet systematic comparisons across common pathogens remain limited. We aimed to characterize symptom signatures across common respiratory pathogens and to develop approaches that support the prioritization of diagnostic testing across pathogens. Using a large-scale, home-based multiplex PCR testing dataset, we characterized symptom profiles across common respiratory pathogens stratified by age and sex. Hierarchical clustering was applied to group pathogens into symptom-based categories, and a multilayer perceptron (MLP) model was trained to predict these cluster-level categories. A post-hoc refinement combined MLP outputs with contemporaneous epidemiological data to further prioritize likely pathogens within predicted categories. Model performance was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), classification accuracy, and related metrics. Symptom profiles overlapped substantially across pathogens, with differences being more categorical than pathogen-specific: RSV, HCoV, HPIV, and HRV were predominantly characterized by respiratory symptoms, whereas influenza A/B and SARS-CoV-2 showed more pronounced systemic manifestations. The MLP model achieved high AUCs (0.80-0.92, depending on age group) with specificities exceeding 75% but lower sensitivities, reflecting a conservative prediction pattern. Integrating cluster-level predictions with contemporaneous epidemiology improved the prioritization of prevalent pathogens, though performance remained limited for less common ones. When expanding predictions to the top three likely pathogens, the model enabled diagnostic test prioritization with an overall accuracy of 0.83 (95% CI, 0.82-0.84). Our study supports the use of readily available symptom data to inform the prioritization of diagnostic testing, particularly during outbreaks or in resource-limited settings where timely laboratory testing is constrained. In addition, the systematic symptom signatures identified across common respiratory pathogens may inform the development and optimization of symptom-based patient-reported outcomes for future antiviral trials.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to distinguish common respiratory pathogens using symptom profiles to prioritize diagnostic testing. Using a large-scale home-based multiplex PCR dataset, the authors characterized symptom signatures across pathogens and trained a multilayer perceptron model to predict symptom-based pathogen clusters. Symptom profiles overlapped substantially, with RSV predominantly showing respiratory symptoms. The model achieved high AUCs (0.80–0.92) and specificities exceeding 75%, though sensitivities were lower. Integrating model outputs with epidemiological data improved pathogen prioritization, enabling diagnostic test prioritization with an overall accuracy of 0.83. The authors conclude that readily available symptom data can support diagnostic prioritization, especially during outbreaks or in resource-limited settings, and that identified symptom signatures may inform future antiviral trial design.

papers.title: LNP-CpG: deploy the self-adjuvant role of mRNA vaccines
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of mRNA vaccines, lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) have emerged as pivotal carriers and adjuvants for non-mRNA vaccine modalities, driven by their superior nucleic acid delivery efficiency and intrinsic self-adjuvanting properties. In this study, we systematically evaluated various formulation strategies combining LNPs and the CpG adjuvant within a varicella-zoster virus glycoprotein E (VZV-gE) subunit vaccine framework. We demonstrated that uniform nanoparticles formed by LNP-encapsulated CpG (LNP-CpG), when simply admixed with the gE antigen, elicited superior immunogenicity compared to alternative encapsulation configurations. Intramuscular administration of a two-dose (LNP-CpG)+gE regimen significantly augmented both humoral and cellular immune responses in mice, markedly outperforming the commercial vaccine Shingrix (administered at a 1/10 human dose). Crucially, the identical regimen induced robust, comparable immune profiles to a full human dose of Shingrix in rhesus macaques. Furthermore, LNP-CpG displayed broad-spectrum utility across diverse vaccine platforms, demonstrating efficacy against both respiratory (RSV) and neurotropic (HSV) pathogens, compatibility with multiple modalities, including subunit (VZV-gE, RSV-Pre-F), live-attenuated (LA-HSV), and inactivated (i-HSV) vaccines; and versatile implementation in a combined VZV+RSV formulation. Collectively, our findings position LNP-CpG as a versatile, safe, highly efficacious adjuvant platform with substantial clinical translational potential, offering a compelling paradigm for next-generation vaccine development.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need to enhance immunogenicity of subunit vaccines by leveraging lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) as carriers and adjuvants, building on their nucleic acid delivery efficiency and intrinsic self-adjuvanting properties.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research systematically evaluated LNP-CpG formulations combined with varicella-zoster virus glycoprotein E (VZV-gE) in a subunit vaccine framework, assessing immunogenicity in mice and rhesus macaques.
analysis.methods: The authors compared LNP-encapsulated CpG (LNP-CpG) admixed with gE antigen against alternative encapsulation configurations and benchmarked responses against the commercial vaccine Shingrix.
analysis.main_results: In mice, intramuscular administration of a two-dose (LNP-CpG)+gE regimen significantly augmented both humoral and cellular immune responses, outperforming a 1/10 human dose of Shingrix, and induced comparable immune profiles to a full human dose of Shingrix in rhesus macaques.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret LNP-CpG as a versatile adjuvant platform with broad-spectrum utility across multiple vaccine modalities and pathogens, highlighting its translational potential for next-generation vaccine development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest LNP-CpG could improve vaccine efficacy and flexibility, offering a promising approach for enhancing protection against diverse pathogens including respiratory viruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to preclinical models (mice and macaques) and does not report human clinical trial data, which constrains direct translational claims and generalizability to human populations.

analysis.summary_en: This preprint evaluates LNP-CpG as a self-adjuvanting platform for subunit vaccines, focusing on varicella-zoster virus glycoprotein E (VZV-gE). The study demonstrates that LNP-encapsulated CpG (LNP-CpG) admixed with gE antigen elicits superior immunogenicity in mice compared to alternative formulations and outperforms a 1/10 human dose of the commercial vaccine Shingrix. In rhesus macaques, the same regimen induces immune responses comparable to a full human dose of Shingrix. The authors further show that LNP-CpG is effective across multiple vaccine modalities and pathogens, including respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and herpes simplex virus (HSV), and can be implemented in combined formulations. While the results are promising, the study is limited to preclinical models and lacks human clinical data, which restricts the strength of translational claims.

papers.abstract_zh: 随着 mRNA 疫苗 的快速发展,脂质纳米颗粒 (LNP) 因其卓越的核酸递送效率和内在的自我辅助特性而成为非 mRNA 疫苗 模式的关键载体和佐剂。在这项研究中,我们系统地评估了水痘带状疱疹病毒糖蛋白 E (VZV-gE) 亚基 疫苗 框架内结合 LNP 和 CpG 佐剂的各种制剂策略。我们证明,由 LNP 封装的 CpG (LNP-CpG) 形成的均匀纳米颗粒,当与 gE 抗原简单混合时,与其他封装配置相比,可引发优异的免疫原性。肌内注射两剂量 (LNP-CpG)+gE 方案可显着增强小鼠的体液和细胞 免疫应答,明显优于商业 疫苗 Shingrix(以 1/10 人类剂量施用)。至关重要的是,相同的治疗方案在恒河猴中诱导出与人用全剂量 Shingrix 相当的强大的免疫特征。此外,LNP-CpG 在不同的 疫苗 平台上显示出广谱效用,证明了对呼吸道 (RSV) 和嗜神经 (HSV) 病原体的功效,与多种模式的兼容性,包括亚基 (VZV-gE、RSV-Pre-F)、减毒活 (LA-HSV) 和灭活 (i-HSV) 疫苗;以及 VZV+RSV 组合配方中的多功能实施。总的来说,我们的研究结果将 LNP-CpG 定位为一种多功能、安全、高效的佐剂平台,具有巨大的临床转化潜力,为下一代 疫苗 开发提供了令人信服的范例。

papers.title: Development of an Agnostic Clinical Metagenomic Workflow for Respiratory RNA Viruses
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Clinical metagenomics has the potential to provide an agnostic approach to respiratory virus diagnostics, but there are substantial methodological challenges. Viral loads vary by orders of magnitude among respiratory samples and nucleic acid extracts are dominated by non-target sequences, particularly for samples from the upper respiratory tract. This necessitates upstream virus enrichment and non-specific amplification approaches adaptable to high-throughput assays. We aimed to develop such a workflow for respiratory RNA viruses. Methods We used nasopharyngeal swabs in viral transport medium remaining after routine microbiological testing of clinical samples at Oxford University Hospital NHS Foundation Trust (UK) was completed. Pre-extraction virus enrichment and non-target nucleic acid depletion methods evaluated included differential centrifugation, bead-beating, nuclease treatment and virus precipitation. RNA was extracted, then reverse transcribed using random N 9 priming to include the oligonucleotide (5’-GATGATAGTAGGGCTTCGTCAC-N 9 -3’) used in subsequent amplification. Two amplification approaches were designed and compared side-by-side: isothermal multiple displacement amplification via Equiphi29 DNA polymerase using circularised template versus PCR-based sequence independent single primer amplification. Sequencing used the Oxford Nanopore Technologies platform. Results Our final optimised workflow combined multiple approaches to virus enrichment; sample clarification (3,200g centrifugation, 30 minutes), nuclease treatment, virus precipitation and centrifugation (13,200g, 30 minutes). RNA was extracted from the resultant pellet. Sequence independent single primer amplification was adopted in the final workflow as it consistently out-performed multiple displacement amplification. During development work, we detected a wide range of respiratory viruses, including coronaviruses (SARS-Cov-2, OC43, NC63, 229E), influenza A and B, respiratory syncytial virus, parainfluenza 2, 3 and 4, human metapneumovirus, human rhino- and enteroviruses, together with an extraction control (MS2) and controls for reverse transcription and amplification controls (Zika, murine respirovirus and orthoreovirus RNA). Conclusions We have developed an agnostic clinical metagenomics workflow for RNA respiratory viruses, with potential for use in molecular diagnostics. Subsequent work will determine sensitivity and specificity relative to performance current standard-of-care diagnostics such as commercial respiratory PCR panels.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Clinical metagenomics offers an agnostic approach to respiratory virus diagnostics, but methodological challenges hinder its effectiveness. This study aimed to address these challenges by developing a workflow for respiratory RNA viruses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated viral loads and nucleic acid extracts from nasopharyngeal swabs collected at Oxford University Hospital NHS Foundation Trust (UK). These samples were used to test various enrichment and depletion methods for respiratory viruses.
analysis.methods: The workflow involved pre-extraction virus enrichment techniques such as differential centrifugation, bead-beating, nuclease treatment, and virus precipitation. RNA was extracted and reverse transcribed using a specific oligonucleotide primer for subsequent amplification.
analysis.main_results: The final workflow combined sample clarification, nuclease treatment, virus precipitation, and centrifugation to optimize virus enrichment. Sequence independent single primer amplification was selected as it outperformed multiple displacement amplification.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings as demonstrating a robust agnostic workflow for respiratory RNA viruses, which could enhance molecular diagnostics. This approach is novel in its integration of multiple enrichment methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings have implications for improving the detection of respiratory viruses in clinical settings, potentially enhancing diagnostic accuracy and informing public health surveillance strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, which may lack detailed statistical analysis or long-term validation. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of comprehensive data on sensitivity and specificity.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop an agnostic clinical metagenomics workflow for respiratory RNA viruses. The researchers evaluated various methods for virus enrichment and nucleic acid depletion, including differential centrifugation, bead-beating, nuclease treatment, and virus precipitation. They found that combining these techniques with sequence independent single primer amplification yielded the best results. The workflow was designed to address the challenges of detecting respiratory viruses in clinical samples, where viral loads vary significantly and non-target sequences dominate. The study highlights the potential of this approach for molecular diagnostics but is limited to abstract-only evidence, which may not provide sufficient detail for full validation. The findings could inform future research and public health strategies for respiratory virus surveillance.

papers.title: TREATMENT AND CLINICAL MANAGEMENT PROTOCOLS FOR ACUTE VIRAL BRONCHIOLITIS IN INFANTS
papers.abstract: Objective: To critically review recent scientific evidence regarding treatment protocols and clinical management of acute viral bronchiolitis in infants, emphasizing supportive interventions, pharmacological therapies, respiratory support, and strategies for preventing respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection. Methods: A narrative literature review was conducted using PubMed, employing keywords related to viral bronchiolitis and therapeutic interventions. Priority was given to recent studies addressing the clinical and therapeutic management of acute viral bronchiolitis in infants, including systematic reviews, clinical trials, and evidence-based guidelines. Results: The analyzed evidence reinforces that the management of acute viral bronchiolitis remains predominantly based on supportive measures, ensuring adequate oxygenation, hydration, and nutrition. Low-flow oxygen therapy is the initial approach for patients with hypoxemia, whereas high-flow nasal cannula therapy may reduce the need for escalation of care when conventional support is insufficient. Bronchodilators, epinephrine, corticosteroids, and antibiotics do not show consistent clinical benefit to justify their routine use. Nebulized hypertonic saline may provide a modest reduction in the length of hospital stay, but the low certainty of the evidence limits its systematic recommendation. Regarding the prevention of RSV-associated disease, palivizumab remains an option for selected infants at higher risk of severe disease, while nirsevimab and maternal immunization expand the available prevention strategies. Conclusion: Contemporary management of acute viral bronchiolitis should prioritize supportive measures and the judicious, stepped use of respiratory support, avoiding pharmacological interventions that lack proven clinical benefit. Despite recent advances, gaps remain regarding the selection and escalation of respiratory support modalities. The incorporation of new RSV prevention strategies expands the possibilities for reducing the disease burden, reinforcing the need to periodically update clinical protocols in light of the best available evidence.
papers.journal: International Journal of Health Management Review

source_records.abstract: Objective: To critically review recent scientific evidence regarding treatment protocols and clinical management of acute viral bronchiolitis in infants, emphasizing supportive interventions, pharmacological therapies, respiratory support, and strategies for preventing respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection. Methods: A narrative literature review was conducted using PubMed, employing keywords related to viral bronchiolitis and therapeutic interventions. Priority was given to recent studies addressing the clinical and therapeutic management of acute viral bronchiolitis in infants, including systematic reviews, clinical trials, and evidence-based guidelines. Results: The analyzed evidence reinforces that the management of acute viral bronchiolitis remains predominantly based on supportive measures, ensuring adequate oxygenation, hydration, and nutrition. Low-flow oxygen therapy is the initial approach for patients with hypoxemia, whereas high-flow nasal cannula therapy may reduce the need for escalation of care when conventional support is insufficient. Bronchodilators, epinephrine, corticosteroids, and antibiotics do not show consistent clinical benefit to justify their routine use. Nebulized hypertonic saline may provide a modest reduction in the length of hospital stay, but the low certainty of the evidence limits its systematic recommendation. Regarding the prevention of RSV-associated disease, palivizumab remains an option for selected infants at higher risk of severe disease, while nirsevimab and maternal immunization expand the available prevention strategies. Conclusion: Contemporary management of acute viral bronchiolitis should prioritize supportive measures and the judicious, stepped use of respiratory support, avoiding pharmacological interventions that lack proven clinical benefit. Despite recent advances, gaps remain regarding the selection and escalation of respiratory support modalities. The incorporation of new RSV prevention strategies expands the possibilities for reducing the disease burden, reinforcing the need to periodically update clinical protocols in light of the best available evidence.

papers.title: SIRT1 Activator Resveratrol Attenuates Age-Related Skin Thinning in Mice.
papers.abstract: Aging is associated with thinning of the epidermis and dermis, leading to wrinkles, dryness, and impaired skin barrier function. Sirtuin-1 (SIRT1) is an NAD+-dependent protein deacetylase that suppresses cellular senescence and matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) expression, both of which contribute to skin thinning. Here, we investigated whether dietary resveratrol (RSV), a SIRT1 activator, mitigates age-related skin thinning in mice. Epidermal and dermal thicknesses were significantly reduced in 60-week-old (wo) mice compared with 20-wo mice, and these changes were attenuated by RSV administration (0.4 g/kg diet) from 28 weeks of age for 32 weeks. In the epidermis, the number of Ki67-positive cells decreased in aged mice but was restored by RSV treatment. Although RSV did not alter the number of SIRT1-positive cells, it significantly reduced the number of acetyl-lysine-positive cells, indicating enhanced SIRT1 activity. In the dermis, the immunopositive areas of MMP-9 and MMP-13 increased in aged mice, and these age-associated increases were not observed in RSV-treated aged mice. Phosphorylated SMAD2 levels decreased with age but were not affected by RSV. Furthermore, SIRT1 knockdown in human HaCaT keratinocytes increased p21 expression and senescence-associated β-galactosidase activity. Taken together, these findings suggest that the SIRT1 activator RSV ameliorates age-related skin thinning by suppressing cellular senescence in the epidermis and inhibiting dermal collagen degradation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 衰老与表皮和真皮变薄有关,导致皱纹、干燥和皮肤屏障功能受损。该研究旨在调查膳食白藜芦醇(RSV)(一种 SIRT1 激活剂)是否可以减轻小鼠与年龄相关的皮肤变薄。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究以小鼠为对象,测量了 20 只和 60 只小鼠的表皮和真皮厚度。从 28 周龄开始,对 60 只小鼠进行了为期 32 周的 RSV 给药测试。
elements_zh.methods: 使用组织学分析测量表皮和真皮厚度。通过免疫组织化学评估 Ki67 阳性细胞和乙酰赖氨酸阳性细胞的数量。使用蛋白质印迹评估磷酸化 SMAD2 水平。使用 siRNA 敲低人 HaCaT 角质形成细胞中的 SIRT1,并测量 p21 表达和衰老相关的 β-半乳糖苷酶活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 与 20 周龄小鼠相比,60 周龄小鼠的表皮和真皮厚度显着减少,并且这些变化通过 RSV 给药而减弱。在老年小鼠的表皮中,Ki67 阳性细胞的数量减少,但 RSV 治疗 使 Ki67 阳性细胞的数量恢复。RSV 显着减少了乙酰赖氨酸阳性细胞的数量,表明 SIRT1 活性增强。在真皮中,老年小鼠的 MMP-9 和 MMP-13 免疫阳性区域有所增加,但在 RSV 治疗的老年小鼠中并未观察到这些与年龄相关的增加。磷酸化 SMAD2 水平随着年龄的增长而降低,但不受 RSV 的影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,SIRT1 激活剂 RSV 通过抑制表皮细胞衰老和抑制真皮胶原蛋白降解来改善与年龄相关的皮肤变薄。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来研究 SIRT1 在与年龄相关的皮肤变化中的作用以及 SIRT1 激活剂在皮肤衰老治疗干预中的潜在用途提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于小鼠,并未考虑人类的变异性。证据基于组织学和生化分析,结果被解释为暗示一种机制,而不是建立因果关系。研究结果的可信度为中等。

papers.title: Improving Maternal Vaccination: Analysis of Formative Interviews with Prenatal Health Care Providers.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Maternal vaccination rates are low in the United States. Understanding barriers to vaccination for pregnant women from the provider's perspective can help better address these issues. This exploratory study assesses participating prenatal health care providers' beliefs and perspectives regarding maternal vaccination for Tdap, flu, COVID-19, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccines. METHODS: This qualitative study included 24 virtual in-depth interviews with prenatal health care providers (12 physicians, 12 certified nurse midwives) working in rural and urban areas. Thematic analysis was conducted to identify perceived barriers and challenges to prenatal care, provider perceptions and recommendations on Tdap, flu, COVID-19, and RSV vaccines, vaccination resources shared with pregnant women, and vaccine administration practices. RESULTS: Most providers reported pregnant women were receptive to vaccination when benefits and risks of prenatal vaccination were explained. Rural providers identified barriers to care that included limited transportation, lack of access to health care, and language barriers. Findings also indicate prenatal health care providers can foster trust, engage in two-way conversations, and navigate patients' cultural influences when addressing vaccination challenges. CONCLUSION: Provider communication about maternal vaccination should be grounded in an evidence-based, participatory approach. Building trust, recognizing and addressing cultural barriers and access challenges are key to identifying practical steps to support access to and uptake of maternal vaccinations.

papers.title: Association Between Respiratory Vaccines and Risk of Cognitive Impairment, Dementia and Alzheimer’s Disease: A Scoping Review
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Neurocognitive disorders represent a growing burden among older adults. Although respiratory vaccines have demonstrated efficacy and safety in preventing acute respiratory events, their potential impact on the development of chronic neurocognitive disorders, such as cognitive impairment, dementia, and Alzheimer’s disease (AD), has not been extensively explored. The objective of this scoping review was to synthesize and analyze the available evidence on the association between respiratory vaccination and the risk of developing cognitive impairment, dementia, and Alzheimer’s disease. Methods: A scoping review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. A literature search was performed in the PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science databases through 15 June 2026. Studies involving older adults (≥60 years), irrespective of their baseline neurocognitive status, were included. Observational studies (cohort and case–control studies) were considered. Editorials, narrative reviews, and other non-original articles were excluded. Results: Eighteen studies were included, with cohort studies being the predominant design. Four main categories of respiratory vaccines were evaluated: influenza, COVID-19, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and pneumococcal vaccines, in relation to the risk of cognitive impairment, dementia, and AD. Influenza vaccination was associated with a lower risk of dementia and AD, with a potential dose–response relationship observed, whereby a greater number of vaccinations was associated with a greater reduction in risk. Pneumococcal vaccination was also associated with a lower risk of dementia and AD, particularly among individuals who received a greater number of vaccine doses. In contrast, the evidence regarding COVID-19 and RSV vaccines was limited and yielded heterogeneous findings. Conclusions: Influenza and pneumococcal vaccination maybe associated with a lower risk of Alzheimer’s disease and dementia. However, the evidence regarding COVID-19 and RSV vaccines remains limited, and additional studies are needed to clarify their impact on the risk of developing neurocognitive disorders.

papers.title_zh: 呼吸系统 疫苗 与认知障碍、痴呆和阿尔茨海默病风险之间的关联:范围界定综述
papers.source_body_en: Background/Objectives: Neurocognitive disorders represent a growing burden among older adults. Although respiratory vaccines have demonstrated efficacy and safety in preventing acute respiratory events, their potential impact on the development of chronic neurocognitive disorders, such as cognitive impairment, dementia, and Alzheimer’s disease (AD), has not been extensively explored. The objective of this scoping review was to synthesize and analyze the available evidence on the association between respiratory vaccination and the risk of developing cognitive impairment, dementia, and Alzheimer’s disease. Methods: A scoping review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. A literature search was performed in the PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science databases through 15 June 2026. Studies involving older adults (≥60 years), irrespective of their baseline neurocognitive status, were included. Observational studies (cohort and case–control studies) were considered. Editorials, narrative reviews, and other non-original articles were excluded. Results: Eighteen studies were included, with cohort studies being the predominant design. Four main categories of respiratory vaccines were evaluated: influenza, COVID-19, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and pneumococcal vaccines, in relation to the risk of cognitive impairment, dementia, and AD. Influenza vaccination was associated with a lower risk of dementia and AD, with a potential dose–response relationship observed, whereby a greater number of vaccinations was associated with a greater reduction in risk. Pneumococcal vaccination was also associated with a lower risk of dementia and AD, particularly among individuals who received a greater number of vaccine doses. In contrast, the evidence regarding COVID-19 and RSV vaccines was limited and yielded heterogeneous findings. Conclusions: Influenza and pneumococcal vaccination maybe associated with a lower risk of Alzheimer’s disease and dementia. However, the evidence regarding COVID-19 and RSV vaccines remains limited, and additional studies are needed to clarify their impact on the risk of developing neurocognitive disorders.

papers.title: Molecular epidemiology of respiratory viral infections in hospitalized children in Novosibirsk, Russia, 2021–2023
papers.abstract: Background Acute respiratory infections (ARIs) are among the leading global causes of morbidity and mortality in children. While viral agents of ARI are rigorously monitored, other pathogenic organisms and pathobionts — bacteria and fungi native to the host microbiome — remain largely neglected. Adenoviral types also warrant particular attention especially given the widespread use of adenoviral vector vaccines during the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods Oro-nasal swabs collected from 1679 children under the age of 18 hospitalized in Novosibirsk, Russia between February 2021 and June 2023, were tested for the presence of nucleic acids by the diagnostic panel targeting 17 viruses, 12 bacteria and one yeast. Adenovirus-positive samples were additionally fine-typed by Sanger sequencing. Results Overall, 79.15% of samples were positive for at least one of 17 viral pathogens, with RSV (22.87% positives) and RhV (24.54% positives) dominating the etiological structure. Oro-nasal presence for respiratory pathobionts and opportunistic pathogens was 67.96% and 11.49%, respectively. Generally, viral seasonality was typical for continental climate, with only two notable deviations: MpV absence in spring of 2022 followed by earlier December peaks in the same year; an earlier RSV maximum in October 2021 with extended circulation the next epidemic season. Overall, the epidemiology of the analyzed viruses was consistent with worldwide surveillance trends and largely stable between the two later epidemic seasons. In viral-bacterial association analysis we identified two significantly attracted pairs, in which virus is known to facilitate bacterial adherence to respiratory epithelium. Adenovirus fine-typing provided preliminary evidence that serotypes 1, 2, 3, and 7 are the most frequently detected among the typed samples, while vaccine serotype AdV-5 was identified in only two cases. Conclusion Broad target coverage allowed for a comprehensive analysis of epidemiological patterns, highlighting a trend toward stabilization of the etiological structure to pre-pandemic levels, and allowed for prioritization of clinically relevant viral-bacterial associations. Preliminary findings in adenoviral fine-typing are consistent with global trends in serotype prevalence and help address an important gap in regional adenoviral epidemiology.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Acute respiratory infections (ARIs) are a major cause of childhood morbidity and mortality globally, yet the role of respiratory pathobionts and opportunistic pathogens alongside viral agents remains understudied.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study prospectively enrolled 1679 children under 18 years hospitalized in Novosibirsk, Russia between February 2021 and June 2023 to investigate respiratory viral and bacterial etiologies using a comprehensive diagnostic panel.
analysis.methods: Oro-nasal swabs were tested for 17 viruses, 12 bacteria, and one yeast using nucleic acid detection; adenovirus-positive samples underwent Sanger sequencing for fine-typing.
analysis.main_results: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) was detected in 22.87% of samples, making it the second most common viral pathogen after rhinovirus (24.54%), with viral positivity overall at 79.15%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The observed RSV epidemiology aligned with global surveillance trends and showed stabilization toward pre-pandemic patterns, with preliminary adenoviral serotyping indicating dominance of types 1, 2, 3, and 7.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support continued RSV surveillance and highlight the need to monitor adenoviral serotype circulation, particularly in the context of adenoviral vector vaccine use.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s single-centre design and lack of longitudinal follow-up limit generalizability and causal inference, warranting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective hospital-based study in Novosibirsk, Russia, tested 1679 children under 18 years for 17 respiratory viruses, 12 bacteria, and one yeast between February 2021 and June 2023. Using nucleic acid detection and adenoviral fine-typing by Sanger sequencing, the authors found that 79.15% of samples were positive for at least one viral pathogen, with RSV detected in 22.87% of cases, second only to rhinovirus. The epidemiology of RSV mirrored global trends and showed stabilization toward pre-pandemic patterns. Preliminary adenoviral serotyping identified types 1, 2, 3, and 7 as most frequent, while vaccine serotype AdV-5 was rare. The study underscores the importance of comprehensive respiratory pathogen surveillance and supports continued monitoring of adenoviral circulation in the context of vaccine use.

papers.title_zh: 2021-2023 年俄罗斯新西伯利亚住院儿童呼吸道病毒感染的分子 流行病学
papers.source_body_en: Background Acute respiratory infections (ARIs) are among the leading global causes of morbidity and mortality in children. While viral agents of ARI are rigorously monitored, other pathogenic organisms and pathobionts — bacteria and fungi native to the host microbiome — remain largely neglected. Adenoviral types also warrant particular attention especially given the widespread use of adenoviral vector vaccines during the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods Oro-nasal swabs collected from 1679 children under the age of 18 hospitalized in Novosibirsk, Russia between February 2021 and June 2023, were tested for the presence of nucleic acids by the diagnostic panel targeting 17 viruses, 12 bacteria and one yeast. Adenovirus-positive samples were additionally fine-typed by Sanger sequencing. Results Overall, 79.15% of samples were positive for at least one of 17 viral pathogens, with RSV (22.87% positives) and RhV (24.54% positives) dominating the etiological structure. Oro-nasal presence for respiratory pathobionts and opportunistic pathogens was 67.96% and 11.49%, respectively. Generally, viral seasonality was typical for continental climate, with only two notable deviations: MpV absence in spring of 2022 followed by earlier December peaks in the same year; an earlier RSV maximum in October 2021 with extended circulation the next epidemic season. Overall, the epidemiology of the analyzed viruses was consistent with worldwide surveillance trends and largely stable between the two later epidemic seasons. In viral-bacterial association analysis we identified two significantly attracted pairs, in which virus is known to facilitate bacterial adherence to respiratory epithelium. Adenovirus fine-typing provided preliminary evidence that serotypes 1, 2, 3, and 7 are the most frequently detected among the typed samples, while vaccine serotype AdV-5 was identified in only two cases. Conclusion Broad target coverage allowed for a comprehensive analysis of epidemiological patterns, highlighting a trend toward stabilization of the etiological structure to pre-pandemic levels, and allowed for prioritization of clinically relevant viral-bacterial associations. Preliminary findings in adenoviral fine-typing are consistent with global trends in serotype prevalence and help address an important gap in regional adenoviral epidemiology.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 急性呼吸道感染 (ARIs) 是全球儿童发病和 死亡率 的主要原因之一。虽然 ARI 的病毒因子受到严格监测,但其他病原生物和病原体(宿主 微生物组原生的细菌和真菌)仍然在很大程度上被忽视。腺病毒类型也值得特别关注,特别是考虑到腺病毒 媒介 疫苗 在 COVID-19 大流行期间的广泛使用。方法 诊断小组对 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 6 月期间在俄罗斯新西伯利亚住院的 1679 名 18 岁以下儿童采集的口鼻拭子进行了针对 17 种病毒、12 种细菌和 1 种酵母菌的核酸检测。腺病毒阳性样本还通过桑格测序进行精细分型。结果 总体而言,79.15% 的样本对 17 种病毒病原体中的至少一种呈阳性,其中 RSV(22.87% 阳性)和 RhV(24.54% 阳性)在病原学结构中占主导地位。呼吸道病原体和机会性病原体的口鼻存在率分别为 67.96% 和 11.49%。一般来说,病毒季节性是大陆性气候的典型特征,只有两个明显的偏差:2022 年春季没有 MpV,随后同年 12 月初出现峰值;RSV 峰值较早出现在 2021 年 10 月,并在下一个流行季节扩大流通。总体而言,所分析病毒的 流行病学 与全球 监测 趋势一致,并且在随后的两个流行季节之间基本稳定。在病毒-细菌关联分析中,我们发现了两个显着吸引的对,其中病毒已知促进细菌粘附到呼吸道上皮。腺病毒精细分型提供了初步证据,表明血清型1、2、3和7是分型样本中最常检测到的,而疫苗血清型AdV-5仅在两例中被鉴定出。结论 广泛的目标覆盖范围可以对流行病学模式进行全面分析,突出病原学结构稳定至大流行前水平的趋势,并可以优先考虑临床相关的病毒-细菌关联。腺病毒精细分型的初步结果与血清型 患病率 的全球趋势一致,有助于解决区域腺病毒 流行病学 的重要差距。

papers.title: A abordagem clínica da bronquiolite aguda: revisão da literatura
papers.abstract: Acute bronchiolitis is a common respiratory infection in children under two years of age, often caused by the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and is one of the main causes of pediatric hospitalization. The objective of this investigation is to describe the main studies for the clinical approach to acute bronchiolitis in current pediatric literature. The methodology of the present study consists of a literature review with a time frame from 2019 to 2024, in the databases of PubMed, SciELO and EBSCO with the descriptors in English: bronchiolitis, virus, children, pediatrics and the use of the Boolean operators “AND” and “OR”. The analysis allows us to state that the diagnosis is purely clinical, based on symptoms such as wheezing, coughing and difficulty breathing, whereas tests are only used in severe cases. Treatment is supportive, with hydration and oxygen therapy, and there is no consensus on the use of medications such as bronchodilators and corticosteroids. Advances include the use of monoclonal antibodies such as Nirsevimab to prevent RSV, and technologies such as lung ultrasound for diagnosis. It is therefore concluded that bronchiolitis requires evidence-based clinical management, prioritizing non-invasive and humanized approaches. Theoretical reviews are important for pediatric practice and the need for multidisciplinary monitoring in the approach to bronchiolitis.

papers.source_body_en: Acute bronchiolitis is a common respiratory infection in children under two years of age, often caused by the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and is one of the main causes of pediatric hospitalization. The objective of this investigation is to describe the main studies for the clinical approach to acute bronchiolitis in current pediatric literature. The methodology of the present study consists of a literature review with a time frame from 2019 to 2024, in the databases of PubMed, SciELO and EBSCO with the descriptors in English: bronchiolitis, virus, children, pediatrics and the use of the Boolean operators “AND” and “OR”. The analysis allows us to state that the diagnosis is purely clinical, based on symptoms such as wheezing, coughing and difficulty breathing, whereas tests are only used in severe cases. Treatment is supportive, with hydration and oxygen therapy, and there is no consensus on the use of medications such as bronchodilators and corticosteroids. Advances include the use of monoclonal antibodies such as Nirsevimab to prevent RSV, and technologies such as lung ultrasound for diagnosis. It is therefore concluded that bronchiolitis requires evidence-based clinical management, prioritizing non-invasive and humanized approaches. Theoretical reviews are important for pediatric practice and the need for multidisciplinary monitoring in the approach to bronchiolitis.
papers.abstract_zh: 急性毛细支气管炎是两岁以下儿童常见的呼吸道感染,常由呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)引起,是儿科住院的主要原因之一。本调查的目的是描述当前儿科文献中针对急性 毛细支气管炎 临床方法的主要研究。本研究的方法包括对 PubMed、SciELO 和 EBSCO 数据库中 2019 年至 2024 年时间范围的文献综述,英文描述符为:毛细支气管炎、病毒、儿童、儿科,以及布尔运算符“AND”和“OR”的使用。通过分析,我们可以说,诊断 纯粹是临床测试,基于喘息、咳嗽和呼吸困难等症状,而测试仅在严重情况下使用。治疗是支持性的,有水合和氧疗,对于支气管扩张剂和皮质类固醇等药物的使用尚未达成共识。进步包括使用 尼塞韦单抗 等单克隆抗体来预防 RSV,以及使用 诊断 等肺部超声技术。因此得出的结论是,毛细支气管炎 需要循证临床管理,优先考虑非侵入性和人性化的方法。理论回顾对于儿科实践非常重要,并且需要在 毛细支气管炎 方法中进行多学科监测。

papers.title: Investigating the Role of microRNA in Host–Influenza A and Other Respiratory RNA Virus Interactions
papers.abstract: Respiratory RNA viruses extensively reprogram host regulatory networks, thereby influencing viral replication, immune evasion, and disease severity. This review examines microRNAs (miRNAs) as regulatory interfaces in host–virus interactions, focusing on influenza A virus as a paradigmatic model while integrating evidence from other respiratory RNA viruses as SARS-CoV-2 and respiratory syncytial virus. After outlining canonical miRNA biogenesis and its manipulation during infection, we discuss how respiratory RNA viruses converge on shared miRNA-regulated pathways, including interferon and NF-κB signaling, apoptosis, autophagy, cellular metabolism, and redox homeostasis. Within these networks, host miRNAs can directly target viral RNAs and modulate antiviral defenses and inflammation, whereas viruses can reshape miRNA expression to facilitate replication, influencing immunopathology. The possibility that RNA viruses encode authentic miRNAs is also critically evaluated; current evidence indicates that manipulating host miRNA biogenesis machinery and remodeling miRNA networks are more prevalent than producing canonical viral miRNAs. Finally, the potential of circulating miRNAs as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers is considered, as well as the capability of miRNA mimics and antagomiRs to function as host-directed therapeutic strategies. Their clinical translation, however, will require standardized validation, cell- and time-resolved studies, efficient delivery systems, and a careful assessment of specificity, safety, and context-dependent effects.

It highlights how respiratory RNA viruses, including RSV, reprogram host regulatory networks to influence replication, immune evasion, and disease severity. papers.title: A novel combinatorial therapeutic strategy using resveratrol and viral oncolysis for diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma: an in vitro study
papers.abstract: Abstract Pediatric central nervous system (CNS) tumors, specifically Diffuse Midline Gliomas (DMG) are a leading cause of cancer-related deaths in children presenting an unmet need for novel therapeutic development. In this study, we assessed the combined effects of resveratrol (RSV) and the oncolytic herpes simplex virus (oHSV), hrR3 in patient-derived diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG) cell lines. RSV or hrR3 monotherapy resulted in a dose- and time-dependent reduction in cell viability. RSV pretreatment followed by hrR3 infection led to a significantly greater reduction in tumor cell viability than monotherapy. RSV pretreatment further enhanced the replication of hrR3, as evidenced by increased viral titers. Mechanistic analysis showed that the combination therapy was associated with reduced phosphorylation of the signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) and protein kinase B (AKT) signaling pathways, along with increased expression of apoptotic markers, including cleaved caspase-3 and Poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP). analysis.summary_en: This study investigated a novel combinatorial therapeutic strategy using resveratrol and an oncolytic herpes simplex virus (hrR3) for treating Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma (DIPG), a deadly pediatric brain tumor. papers.full_text: Abstract Objectives Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis (IPA) is a life-threatening opportunistic infection, most often seen in severely immunocompromised patients. In patients without classical host factors such as neutropenia, IPA has been described in critically ill patients with influenza and COVID-19. In past years, associations between IPA and other respiratory viruses have been made, especially in immunocompromised hosts. In our institute, we have recently observed multiple critically ill patients with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection and IPA, mostly in patients who had undergone allogeneic hematological stem cell transplantation (HSCT). We evaluated the prevalence and potential risk factors of IPA in critically ill patients with an RSV infection. Methods In a retrospective cohort study between January 1st 2016 and December 31st 2024 patients who had been admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for respiratory support and underwent a bronchoalveolar lavage that was positive for RSV of whom clinical information was available, were included. Data regarding underlying disease, radiology, mycological tests, and mortality were analyzed. Results We identified 16 ICU patients that received respiratory support due to an RSV pneumonia. Of these, five patients (31%) had probable IPA, all of whom had undergone an allogeneic SCT. The 30-day mortality of IPA in these patients was 100%. Patients with an allogeneic HSCT and severe RSV had increased prevalence of IPA compared to RSV negative patients, albeit non-significantly (56% vs. 23%, p = 0.10). Conclusions IPA associated with RSV appears to occur limited to post-allogeneic HSCT recipients and carries a dismal prognosis. Acknowledgements Not applicable. Funding None. papers.title_original: Association between severe RSV pneumonia and invasive pulmonary aspergillosis

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the prevalence and potential risk factors of invasive pulmonary aspergillosis (IPA) in critically ill patients with an RSV infection, as IPA has been previously associated with other respiratory viruses in immunocompromised hosts.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study was conducted between January 1st 2016 and December 31st 2024, including patients admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for respiratory support and who had a bronchoalveolar lavage positive for RSV with available clinical information.
analysis.methods: The study analyzed data on underlying disease, radiology, mycological tests, and mortality from patients who had undergone bronchoalveolar lavage for RSV infection and were admitted to the ICU for respiratory support.
analysis.main_results: Sixteen ICU patients received respiratory support due to RSV pneumonia, of whom five (31%) had probable IPA, and all five had undergone allogeneic stem cell transplantation. The 30-day mortality rate for IPA in these patients was 100%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that IPA associated with RSV appears to occur primarily in post-allogeneic HSCT recipients and has a poor prognosis, highlighting a previously unreported association in this specific patient group.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that in immunocompromised patients with severe RSV infection, particularly those who have undergone allogeneic HSCT, IPA should be considered as a potential complication, informing targeted surveillance and diagnostic strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for selection bias, with a non-significant comparison between RSV-positive and RSV-negative patients for IPA prevalence. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the association between severe RSV pneumonia and invasive pulmonary aspergillosis (IPA) in critically ill patients. It reports that among 16 ICU patients with RSV infection, 5 (31%) had probable IPA, all of whom had undergone allogeneic stem cell transplantation. The 30-day mortality rate for IPA in these patients was 100%. The authors suggest that IPA associated with RSV is limited to post-allogeneic HSCT recipients and has a poor prognosis. The study is a retrospective cohort analysis, which may introduce bias, and the comparison between RSV-positive and RSV-negative patients for IPA prevalence was non-significant. These findings highlight the need for targeted surveillance and diagnostic approaches in immunocompromised patients with severe RSV infection.

papers.title: PEDIATRIC PSEUDOTUMOR CEREBRI SYNDROME IN A PREPUBERTAL NON-OBESE BOY: SILENT VISUAL IMPAIRMENT AND A NORMAL BRAIN MRI - A CASE REPORT
papers.abstract: Background: Pseudotumor cerebri syndrome (PTCS) is characterized by elevated intracranial pressure in the setting of normal cerebrospinal fluid composition and normal or typically altered neuroimaging, once secondary causes have been excluded. In adults the disease classically affects young obese women, but in children the demographic profile is more heterogeneous, with prepubertal patients frequently being non-obese and of either sex. Early recognition is essential because untreated PTCS can cause irreversible visual loss, yet the condition is easily overlooked when the clinical presentation deviates from the adult stereotype. Case presentation: A 6-year-10-month-old prepubertal boy with a history of recurrent upper respiratory tract infections presented with a three-week history of abdominal pain, headache, vomiting, and double vision. Body mass index was 13.67 kg/m2 (non-obese). Fundoscopy disclosed bilateral optic disc edema, and visual acuity was mildly reduced to 0.7 in the right eye and 0.5 in the left eye, although the child did not report visual symptoms. Magnetic resonance imaging of the brain, orbits, and whole spine was unremarkable, and computed tomography findings of low-lying cerebellar tonsils were not confirmed on MRI. Diagnostic lumbar puncture yielded clear, colorless cerebrospinal fluid with normal biochemistry and negative infectious and autoimmune workup. Acetazolamide, intravenous mannitol, and therapeutic lumbar puncture were followed by complete visual recovery (1.0 in each eye) and regression of papilledema within two weeks. Respiratory syncytial virus was treated with supportive care and amoxicillin-clavulanate because of suspected bacterial superinfection. Discussion: This case illustrates three teaching points: PTCS must be considered in prepubertal non-obese children regardless of sex; visual impairment may develop silently and recover fully with prompt treatment; and a normal brain MRI does not exclude the diagnosis, which rests on the combination of clinical features, papilledema, cerebrospinal fluid findings, and exclusion of mimics. Conclusion: Clinicians should maintain a low threshold for fundoscopy and lumbar puncture in any child with suggestive symptoms, irrespective of demographic profile, because timely treatment can prevent permanent visual loss even when the child does not report visual symptoms.
papers.journal: International Journal of Innovative Technologies in Social Science

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:假性脑瘤综合征(PTCS)的特点是在脑脊液成分正常和神经影像学正常或典型改变的情况下,一旦排除次要原因,颅内压就会升高。在成人中,这种疾病通常影响年轻的肥胖女性,但在儿童中,人口统计学特征更加异质,青春期前的患者通常不肥胖且性别不一。早期识别至关重要,因为未经治疗的 PTCS 可能会导致不可逆的视力丧失,但当临床表现偏离成人刻板印象时,这种情况很容易被忽视。病例介绍:一名6岁10个月的青春期前男孩,有反复上呼吸道感染史,有三周腹痛、头痛、呕吐和复视病史。体重指数为 13.67 kg/m2(非肥胖)。眼底镜检查发现双侧视盘水肿,右眼视力轻度下降至0.7,左眼视力轻度下降至0.5,但孩子没有报告视力症状。大脑、眼眶和整个脊柱的磁共振成像没有异常,低位小脑扁桃体的计算机断层扫描结果也没有得到 MRI 的证实。诊断性腰椎穿刺产生透明、无色的脑脊液,生化正常,感染和自身免疫检查结果呈阴性。乙酰唑胺、静脉注射甘露醇和腰椎穿刺治疗后,视力完全恢复(每只眼 1.0),两周内视乳头水肿消退。由于疑似细菌重复感染,呼吸道合胞病毒 接受了支持治疗和阿莫西林克拉维酸治疗。讨论:该案例说明了三个教学要点:无论性别,青春期前非肥胖儿童都必须考虑PTCS;视力障碍可能会悄无声息地发展,并通过提示 治疗 完全恢复;正常的脑 MRI 并不排除 诊断,它依赖于临床特征、视乳头水肿、脑脊液检查结果和排除模仿的结合。结论:对于任何有提示性症状的儿童,无论其人口特征如何,临床医生都应保持较低的眼底镜检查和腰椎穿刺阈值,因为即使儿童没有报告视力症状,及时的 治疗 也可以防止永久性视力丧失。

papers.title: Clinical and epidemiological profiles of six respiratory pathogens in hospitalized children in Lixin County, Anhui, China (2024–2025)
papers.abstract: Background Acute respiratory infections are caused by a diverse range of pathogens. This study aimed to investigate the epidemiological profiles and clinical features of major respiratory pathogens by analyzing their detection rates in hospitalized pediatric patients. Methods Nasopharyngeal swab specimens were retrospectively enrolled from pediatric inpatients diagnosed with acute respiratory infections at the Department of Pediatrics, Lixin County People's Hospital, between February 2024 and August 2025. All specimens were subjected to polymerase chain reaction (PCR) assays targeting six major respiratory pathogens, namely adenovirus, respiratory syncytial virus, influenza A virus, influenza B virus, parainfluenza virus, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae . Based on the PCR results, we further delineated the epidemiological trends, age-stratified distribution, and corresponding clinical profiles associated with each identified pathogen. Results The epidemiological and clinical profiles of the six detected respiratory pathogens are summarized below. In brief, the overall positivity rate of pathogens exhibited winter-spring predominance, with adenovirus and RSV showing the broadest outbreak windows (November–July and November–May, respectively), while influenza A was more restricted (December–March). Mycoplasma pneumoniae displayed a sporadic annual pattern without a statistically significant seasonal peak. analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the epidemiological and clinical profiles of six respiratory pathogens in hospitalized children in Lixin County, Anhui, China, between February 2024 and August 2025. The research aimed to investigate the detection rates and characteristics of these pathogens. Nasopharyngeal swab specimens were tested using PCR to identify the pathogens, and the results showed that respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) had the broadest outbreak window, targeting children aged 1 year. Influenza A showed a more restricted seasonal pattern, while Mycoplasma pneumoniae had a sporadic annual pattern. Clinically, RSV was associated with a significantly higher wheezing rate compared to other pathogens, and febrile seizures were most common in influenza A infections. The study highlights the distinct age distributions and clinical manifestations of these pathogens, which could aid clinicians in identifying the causative agent. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of detailed limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 急性呼吸道感染是由多种病原体引起的。本研究旨在通过分析住院儿科患者中主要呼吸道病原体的检出率,探讨主要呼吸道病原体的流行病学特征和临床特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 回顾性收集2024年2月至2025年8月利辛县人民医院儿科确诊为急性呼吸道感染的儿科住院患者的鼻咽拭子标本。
elements_zh.methods: 所有样本均进行了针对六种主要呼吸道病原体(即腺病毒、呼吸道合胞病毒、甲型流感病毒、乙型流感病毒、副流感病毒和肺炎支原体)的聚合酶链反应(PCR)检测。根据PCR结果,我们进一步描述了与每种已识别病原体相关的流行病学趋势、年龄分层分布以及相应的临床特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 六种检测到的呼吸道病原体的流行病学和临床概况总结如下。简而言之,病原体的总体阳性率表现出冬春优势,其中腺病毒和RSV显示出最宽的暴发窗口(分别为11月至7月和11月至5月),而甲型流感则更为有限(12月至3月)。肺炎支原体表现出零星的年度模式,没有统计上显着的季节性峰值。年龄分布差异很大:RSV 针对 1 岁儿童,而 A 型流感则以婴幼儿为主。临床上,虽然发烧和咳嗽很普遍,但 RSV 的特点是喘息率显着升高(27.57% 对比其他人的 3.97%–9.52%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 不同病原体引起的急性呼吸道感染具有不同的年龄分布和临床表现。这些特征与当地流行病学数据相结合,可以帮助临床医生及时识别可能的致病病原体。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以帮助临床医生及时识别可能的致病病原体。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性。

papers.title: Accelerating protein design by scaling experimental characterization
papers.abstract: Abstract Recent advances in de novo protein design have greatly outpaced standard protein biochemistry workflows, and experimental testing has been a bottleneck in the validation of new designs and methodologies. Here, we describe experimental and computational workflows to address the issues of scale, speed and reproducibility of common in vitro protein testing methods, enabling at least an order of magnitude increase in throughput while reducing wetlab time. Semi-Automated Protein Production (SAPP) is a rapid, modular, scalable and cost-effective protocol, enabling up to milligram-scale protein production, and standardized characterization including yield, dispersity, and oligomeric state of hundreds of designs per day, at the cost-equivalent of a few DNA oligos per construct. End-to-end protocol execution takes 48 hours, with about 6 hours spent benchside using mostly standard laboratory equipment. This protocol has become the standard at our institute, providing critical experimental validation for dozens of projects spanning tens of thousands of designs. We showcase the power of the platform by using it to rapidly characterize de novo designed inhibitors of respiratory syncytial virus. Since at least 80% of SAPP’s total cost comes from synthetic DNA, we also developed a scalable demultiplexing protocol (DMX) to leverage oligo pools as input DNA, providing a further 5-fold reduction in costs, enabling >1000 designs to be purified and characterized in arrayed, clonal format at a cost of $5 per construct. By reframing standard molecular biology practices and orchestrating wetlab workflows with partial automation instead of complex end-to-end robotics, these protocols should be widely adoptable, accelerating protein design.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the bottleneck of experimental testing in de novo protein design, which has advanced faster than standard biochemical workflows. The research sought to develop scalable and efficient methods for validating new protein designs.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study describes experimental and computational workflows designed to enhance the scale, speed, and reproducibility of in vitro protein testing. These protocols were implemented at the institute and tested on de novo designed inhibitors of respiratory syncytial virus.
analysis.methods: The methods involve a Semi-Automated Protein Production (SAPP) protocol, which enables rapid, modular, scalable, and cost-effective protein production and standardized characterization. A scalable demultiplexing protocol (DMX) was also developed to reduce costs by using oligo pools as input DNA.
analysis.main_results: The SAPP protocol allows for the production and characterization of hundreds of protein designs per day, with end-to-end execution taking 48 hours and most benchwork completed in 6 hours. The DMX protocol further reduces costs, enabling over 1000 designs to be purified and characterized at $5 per construct.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these protocols as a transformative approach that reframes standard molecular biology practices, enabling partial automation of wetlab workflows. This innovation provides critical experimental validation for numerous projects involving thousands of designs.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings have significant implications for accelerating protein design, which can inform the development of new therapeutic agents, including inhibitors for respiratory syncytial virus, thereby enhancing surveillance and treatment options.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on abstract-only information, and the study does not provide detailed results or limitations. However, the protocols are described as scalable and cost-effective, with a high confidence assessment due to their adoption as a standard at the institute.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the bottleneck in experimental testing of de novo protein designs by introducing scalable and efficient protocols. The Semi-Automated Protein Production (SAPP) protocol enables rapid, modular, and cost-effective protein production and characterization, while a demultiplexing protocol (DMX) further reduces costs. These methods have been adopted as a standard at the institute, providing critical validation for numerous projects. The findings suggest that these protocols can significantly enhance the speed and throughput of protein design, with potential implications for the development of new therapeutic agents targeting respiratory syncytial virus. The evidence is abstract-only, but the protocols are described as widely adoptable due to their reliance on standard laboratory equipment and partial automation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决从头蛋白质设计中的实验测试瓶颈,该设计的进展速度比标准生化工作流程更快。该研究试图开发可扩展且有效的方法来验证新的蛋白质设计。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究描述了旨在提高体外蛋白质测试的规模、速度和可重复性的实验和计算工作流程。这些方案在该研究所实施,并在从头设计的 呼吸道合胞病毒 抑制剂上进行了测试。
elements_zh.methods: 该方法涉及半自动化蛋白质生产(SAPP)方案,可实现快速、模块化、可扩展且成本效益高的蛋白质生产与标准化表征。此外,还开发了一种可扩展的解复用方案(DMX),通过使用寡核苷酸池作为输入DNA来降低成本。
elements_zh.main_results: SAPP 协议每天可以生产和表征数百种蛋白质设计,端到端执行需要 48 小时,大多数实验工作在 6 小时内完成。DMX 协议进一步降低了成本,能够以每个构造 5 美元的价格纯化和表征 1000 多种设计。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些协议解释为一种变革性方法,可以重新构建标准分子生物学实践,从而实现湿实验室工作流程的部分自动化。这项创新为涉及数千种设计的众多项目提供了关键的实验验证。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对于加速蛋白质设计具有重要意义,可以为新治疗药物的开发提供信息,包括 呼吸道合胞病毒 抑制剂,从而增强 监测 和 治疗 的选择。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅基于抽象信息,并且该研究没有提供详细的结果或局限性。然而,这些协议被描述为可扩展且具有成本效益,并且由于被采纳为研究所的标准而具有高可信度评估。

papers.title: Molecular and clinical characterization of human adenovirus in hospitalized pediatric respiratory infections: a five-year study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Human adenovirus (HAdV) is a major pathogen of responsible for respiratory tract infections (RTIs) in children in China. This study analyzed clinical data from hospitalized pediatric HAdV infections over a five-year period to characterize the epidemiology, clinical manifestations, and associations with different genotypes and co-detections. Methods A retrospective analysis was conducted on 42,044 hospitalized children with RTIs admitted to Hebei Children’s Hospital between 2016 and 2020. Sputum were collected for viral nucleic acid detection and HAdV genotyping, along with demographic, clinical, and laboratory data. Statistical analyses included χ2 tests, Mann–Whitney U tests, and Kruskal–Wallis tests. Neighbor-joining method was used to construct the phylogenetic tree. Results Among 42,044 samples, 3,123 (7.43%) tested positive for HAdV. Of these, 1,954 (62.6%) had viral co-detection, most commonly with HRV, RSV, and HPIV. The highest HAdV infection rate occurred in children aged 1–3 years (χ2 = 418.44, P < 0.001). HAdV-3 and HAdV-7 were the predominant genotypes in both single and co-infections (χ2 = 22.227, P = 0.014). HAdV-7 was more frequently detected in patients with severe clinical manifestations, accompanied by decreased immune indices and elevated levels of procalcitonin, D-dimer, as well as cardiac and liver injury markers. Conclusion HAdV-3 and HAdV-7 are the predominant strains circulating in Hebei Province and primarily affect hospitalized children aged 1–3 years. HAdV-7 was associated with more severe diseases. HAdV genotyping sequence exhibit high genetic similarity across different countries.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to characterize the epidemiology, clinical manifestations, and associations of human adenovirus (HAdV) with different genotypes and co-detections in hospitalized pediatric respiratory infections in China. The background highlights HAdV as a major pathogen responsible for respiratory tract infections (RTIs) in children.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 42,044 hospitalized children with respiratory tract infections (RTIs) admitted to Hebei Children’s Hospital between 2016 and 2020. The study focused on HAdV infections and their co-occurrence with other pathogens.
analysis.methods: Clinical data and sputum samples were collected for viral nucleic acid detection and HAdV genotyping. Statistical analyses included χ2 tests, Mann–Whitney U tests, and Kruskal–Wallis tests to evaluate associations and differences.
analysis.main_results: Among 42,044 samples, 3,123 (7.43%) tested positive for HAdV. Of these, 1,954 (62.6%) had viral co-detection, most commonly with HRV, RSV, and HPIV. HAdV-7 was more frequently detected in patients with severe clinical manifestations.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that HAdV-3 and HAdV-7 are the predominant strains circulating in Hebei Province and primarily affect hospitalized children aged 1–3 years. They also noted that HAdV-7 is associated with more severe diseases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the epidemiology and clinical impact of HAdV in hospitalized pediatric respiratory infections, which can inform surveillance and diagnostic strategies in the region.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on retrospective data, which may introduce bias and limit the ability to establish causality. The evidence is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and the lack of prospective controls.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the role of human adenovirus (HAdV) in hospitalized pediatric respiratory infections in China over five years. It analyzed clinical data from 42,044 children and found that 7.43% tested positive for HAdV, with co-detections common. HAdV-3 and HAdV-7 were the most prevalent genotypes, particularly affecting children aged 1–3 years. HAdV-7 was linked to more severe clinical outcomes. The study used statistical tests to evaluate associations but was limited by its retrospective design. These findings contribute to understanding HAdV's epidemiology and clinical impact, offering potential insights for surveillance and diagnostic efforts in the region.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述 流行病学、临床表现以及人腺病毒(HAdV)不同基因型及共感染与中国住院儿童呼吸道感染的关联。背景部分强调 HAdV 是儿童呼吸道感染(RTIs)的主要病原体。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2016年至2020年河北省儿童医院收治的42044例呼吸道感染(RTI)住院儿童进行回顾性分析。该研究重点关注HAdV感染及其与其他病原体的共存情况。
elements_zh.methods: 收集临床数据和痰样本进行病毒核酸检测和HAdV基因分型。统计分析包括 χ2 检验、Mann-Whitney U 检验和 Kruskal-Wallis 检验,以评估关联性和差异。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 42,044 份样本中,3,123 份(7.43%)HAdV 检测结果为阳性。其中,1,954 份(62.6%)存在病毒共感染,最常见的共感染病毒为 HRV、RSV 和 HPIV。HAdV-7 在重症临床表现患者中检出率更高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论:HAdV-3 和 HAdV-7 是河北省流行的主要毒株,主要影响 1–3 岁住院儿童。研究还指出 HAdV-7 与更严重的疾病相关。
